photos.alt: The colonial before construction, seen head-on from the street: a two-story main house beside a single-story two-car garage wing sitting under a lower roofline, with tan siding and brown shutters
The same house before construction from the driveway, showing the garage wing roof meeting the main house well below the second-floor windows
Rear of the house before construction, with the original single-story wing, brick chimney, and a raised deck off the back overlooking the yard

The new second story mid-build, framed and dried in: stud walls and roof rafters exposed, exterior sheathing and insulation board in place, double-hung windows set, and rough electrical run to open boxes over a bare subfloor

Second-floor hallway mid-build, looking down the framed corridor: exposed stud walls and roof rafters, flexible duct and wiring run overhead, recessed light housings hung, and new windows set above a bare subfloor
The house from the driveway mid-build, with the new second story sheathed over the garage, roof shingled and windows installed, and a skip and work truck in the drive
A framed second-floor bedroom with vaulted rafters overhead, three new windows set, recessed light housings hung, and the first sheets of drywall stacked against the studs
The rear elevation mid-build, with the new second story sheathed and roofed above the original single-story wing, standing alongside the brick chimney

The new bathroom mid-tile, with blue onyx-look large-format tile set on the shower walls behind yellow levelling clips, a recessed niche framed out, and taped moisture-resistant board on the surrounding walls
The upstairs hall at finishing stage, painted white with doors hung and recessed lighting on, red oak flooring going down under builder's paper, and the new stair posts standing unfinished
The second-floor landing at finishing stage, with oak flooring laid, doors hung and painted, a flush ceiling fixture on, and drop cloths still down on the far side

The new bathroom near completion, with a blue onyx-look tile shower, chrome fixtures and hand shower, an arched white oak wall cabinet, and a wide trough sink, protective film and floor tape still in place

The new second story finished from the street in spring, siding, trim and roofline matched to the original house, with a cherry tree in bloom out front and a dumpster still in the drive as the site is cleared
The completed house from the street, with the full second story built over the two-car garage, clad in matching siding with dark shutters and garage doors, and the lawn re-established
A finished bedroom in the new second story, painted soft blue with white trim, a mirrored closet, a ceiling fan, and red oak flooring
A second finished bedroom in the addition, painted soft blue with white trim and sills, three new windows on two walls, a ceiling fan, and red oak flooring
The finished bathroom, with a blue onyx-look tile shower behind a sliding glass door, a patterned tile niche, an arched white oak wall cabinet, and a pedestal sink
The finished stair landing, with a white oak handrail and newel posts, black metal balusters, and red oak flooring running through to the new bedrooms

The bath during demolition, walls stripped back to the studs with drywall debris across the floor, plumbing stacks and rough electrical boxes exposed, and a work platform standing in the middle of the room
New subfloor and cement-board underlayment down at floor level, with a stud wall framed out for the vanity and rough wiring hanging from the opened wall beside the window
The shower area during rough-in, its curbed base and surrounding walls sheathed in cement board with the drain set in a sloped mortar bed, and orange Ditra underlayment covering the adjoining floor
Large-format marble-look floor tile being set, with yellow levelling clips at every joint, cut pieces staged across the finished run, and the plumbing wall still open to the studs

The finished bath from the doorway: a toilet screened by a half-wall carrying the bidet seat controls, the light oak double vanity with marble-look counters beyond, and the freestanding tub in the window bay
The double vanity run in light oak under brass-framed mirrors and glass sconces, with the freestanding tub and its brass floor-mounted filler at the windows beyond
The double vanity head-on, two undermount sinks set in a marble-look counter with a matching backsplash, brass faucets and pulls, and a pair of brass-framed mirrors beneath glass sconces
The freestanding oval tub centred under the triple casement window, with a brass floor-mounted filler and hand shower and a recessed niche in the wall to the right
The tub bay and the walk-in shower beside it, the shower enclosed in frameless glass with marble-look wall tile and a brass rain head, and two recessed niches in the wall between them

The walk-in shower seen from the bath, frameless glass over a half-wall with a brass towel bar, large-format marble-look wall tile, a brass rain head and hand shower, and a hexagon marble mosaic floor
The shower's glass corner under the skylight, marble-look tile carried up both walls with a rain head on each, and a square drain grate set into the hexagon mosaic floor
Inside the shower, a full wall of marble-look tile with twin rain heads, two brass mixing valves, a hand shower on a holder, and a tiled bench running across the back
Open basement room with an egress window, a white storage cabinet, and the black cable-rail staircase beside a closet with a built-in shelf
Basement rec room with a white painted brick fireplace and black glass doors, an elliptical trainer, and adjustable dumbbells on a rack
Basement bathroom vanity in gray shaker cabinetry with a white integrated sink top, brushed nickel faucet, round mirror, and a wall sconce above
Basement laundry and utility room with a top-load washer and dryer, a white sink cabinet, the electrical panel on the far wall, and a rear exterior door
Laundry room with a stainless utility sink set in white cabinetry, a washer and dryer alongside, and gray double closet doors opposite
Finished basement hallway with gray louvered bifold closet doors and a rolling steel workbench with a butcher-block top along the far wall
Basement utility area with open cedar storage shelving, a rolling steel workbench, and an open door to the room with the white brick fireplace
Basement storage room with open cedar shelving and wire baskets, a white refrigerator, and the laundry room through the opening beyond
